{"id":"project-LICHEN-94ju","title":"[epic] Extract Renode Meshtastic board definitions as standalone project","description":"Phase 2: Add Meshtastic board definitions to renode-lora-peripherals monorepo.

SCOPE:

DELIVERABLE: Meshtastic devs can test firmware in Renode
